Vendored, redistributable third-party material. Each subdirectory preserves its

## buwizz-pro3-bluetooth-python

- **Upstream:** https://github.com/neozenith/buwizz-pro3-bluetooth-python
- **License:** MIT (© 2023 Josh Peak) — see `buwizz-pro3-bluetooth-python/LICENSE`
- **Imported:** `LICENSE`, `README.md`, `pyproject.toml`, and the library source

This is kept as a reference implementation. The actively developed library in
